rejected.reason: Parenthetical strings in the examples are cross-reference tracking aliases and glosses. Normalizing or dropping an alias variant is entity resolution, not a granularity rung.
Sponsoring agencies or military bodies belong to distinct categories (e.g., GovernmentOrganization / MilitaryUnit), violating the same-category requirement.
Broad threat classification labels represent category descriptions or threat roles rather than valid coarser entity instances.

ladder.notes: The observed examples consist solely of threat group names and vendor/cert tracking identifiers (such as UAC and APT numbers), alongside parenthetical alias cross-references. No intra-category hierarchical containment (such as subdivisions, distinct operational units, or multi-group cartels) is established in the evidence, so the category contains only g0.
